mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.outbound_order_id, d.sku_id, d.consignor_id, d.batch_number, d.expire_date, d.out_count, d.allocated_count, d.picked_count, d.review_count, d.review_status, d.shortage_handle, d.target_warehouse_id, d.target_warehouse_area_id, d.target_warehouse_area_loca_id, d.pick_status, d.pick_emp_id, d.pick_time, k.code AS sku_code, COALESCE(k.title, s.title) AS sku_name, k.code AS bar_code, k.spec AS spec, IFNULL(k.is_sn_managed, 0) AS is_sn_managed, k.product_weight AS product_weight, s.weight_unit AS weight_unit, s.title AS spu_name, s.storage_condition AS storage_condition, s.near_expire_days AS near_expire_days, c.consignor_name AS consignor_name, a.name AS area_name, l.loca_code AS loca_code FROM wms_outbound_order_details d LEFT JOIN wms_item_sku k ON k.id = d.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_item_spu s ON s.id = k.spu_id LEFT JOIN wms_consignor c ON c.id = d.consignor_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse_area a ON a.id = d.target_warehouse_area_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse_area_loca l ON l.id = d.target_warehouse_area_loca_id WHERE d.outbound_order_id = #{outboundOrderId} AND d.is_del = 1 ORDER BY d.id ASC
